t: Forge Steel F-clamp 2-pack designed for securing workpieces during gluing, drilling, and assembly tasks. Each robust clamp offers a 150mm clamping capacity, ideal for use by professional carpenters, or in busy workshops for reliable hold-down support. Featuring an I-beam design for high mechanical strength and reduced torsion, the clamps are designed to ensure stability. Grey cast iron jaws and a cast iron bar provide durability, whilst the ergonomic polypropylene handle ensures improved comfort and grip. Also includes soft plastic protective jaw guards to prevent surface damage. The screw-handle system delivers precise tightening and a maximum clamping force of 1372 kg/m².
